label: Breaking every cycle
subgoals: Identify every cycle in the graph.
Choose at least one vertex from each cycle.
Verify that the remaining graph is a forest.

label: Testing a proposed set
subgoals: Remove the proposed vertices from the graph.
Inspect each cycle for a removed vertex.
Count the cycles that remain intact.

label: Counting the remaining forest
subgoals: Use the fact that a cycle of length L leaves L - 2 edges.
Check that the result is at most n - 1.
